ns2:section.sectionText: Do you want to learn more about video editing? Want to learn about UIUC history and the innovations that came from it? Innovation Illinois, an 8-week accelerated course starting October 23, is perfect for you! This course introduces the histories of interdisciplinary innovations from the Urbana-Champaign campus that bridged students and researchers in engineering, humanities, sciences and the arts. We will explore how local histories of Illinois innovations help us understand today’s innovation trends and processes, from the growth of new design centers on university campuses to contemporary accessibility design. As part of a final research project, students will be introduced to the basics of video editing and team produce a short-form video using a variety of primary sources, from interviews and news media to materials drawn from the University Archives.
